name: client-side-server-demo
description: A Hono server compiled to WebAssembly (WASI) running inside a browser tab, reachable with curl

scripts.build:component: rolldown -c && jco componentize -w wit -o dist/component.wasm dist/component.js
scripts.build:transpile: jco transpile dist/component.wasm -o dist/transpiled --name server --instantiation async
scripts.build: npm run build:component && npm run build:transpile && npm run build:web
